title: Lewis Hamilton addresses Kim Kardashian relationship for first time, thanks her for ‘support’ at Monaco
content:
Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton publicly addressed his relationship with Kim Kardashian for the first time, saying that it was “amazing” to have her at the Monaco Grand Prix.

Hamilton finished second in Sunday’s race behind Mercedes’ Kimi Antonelli, scoring his second consecutive podium finish and promoting him to second in the driver’s championship.

The seven-time Formula 1 world champion is enjoying a resurgence at Ferrari after a difficult first season with the Italian team, finishing sixth in the championship, 86 points behind teammate Charles Leclerc. He failed to score a podium last campaign and only recorded a finish higher than seventh once in the second half of the season, when he came fourth in Mexico.

This year, Hamilton has not finished lower than sixth in a grand prix, with Ferrari second in the constructors’ standings.

Hamilton, 41, and Kardashian, 45, have widely been reported to be dating for a number of months, with the pair spotted together at the Super Bowl in February and the Coachella music festival in California in April. On Tuesday, the reality TV star posted images of her and Hamilton together on Instagram for the first time.

During the podium celebrations at Monaco, Hamilton appeared to blow a kiss in her direction.

After the race, Hamilton did not directly address his relationship status with Kardashian but thanked her for her support.

“It’s amazing to have her come this weekend and have the support,” Hamilton said in the post-race press conference.

“But, you know, with my friends, incredible turnout, just overall, the people.

“It’s amazing to have good people around you and good people supporting you and she does that for me every day.”

Hamilton had previously refused to comment on speculation surrounding his relationship, describing it as “private life” at preseason testing in Bahrain.

F1 heads to Barcelona this weekend for the seventh race of the season.
